text:
Ambushed in my writing

you sing in my poem.

Hostage of your sweet voice

petrified in my memory.

Bird clinging to its flight.

Air tattooed by an absent one.

Clock that beats with me

so that I never wake.

translation.title: Ambushed in My Writing...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the paradoxes of capture and flight that structure the poem.
